Uses professional purchasing skills and concepts to complete purchasing assignments of moderate complexity requiring the analysis and review of multiple procurement options. Has authority to make purchases within a moderate and pre-approved dollar limit, including purchasing all vertebrate laboratory animals on behalf of UCI researchers. Exercises judgment within defined limits and practices to determine most effective methodology to acquire common goods and services, including laboratory animals, vivarium items, and office supplies.

Works on problems of moderate scope where analysis of situations or data requires a review of a variety of factors.Coordinates animal acquisitions with researchers and vivarium staff to support the University’s research and teaching missions.Monitors departmental purchases for cost tracking purposes, including maintaining multiple spreadsheets as part of annual cost analysis. Assists with general administrative duties in the Department including processing reimbursements, issuing card keys, and other tasks as needed.The position requires diplomacy, tact, and a strong willingness to assist investigators in the selection and ordering of animals. Strong communication skills are necessary to coordinate animal shipments with veterinary and husbandry staff regarding space availability and health requirements for incoming animals.
